listing.title: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair Hackathon | Superteam Australia Track
listing.description:
Australia has some of the best builders in the world. Now it is time to prove it on the global stage.

Superteam Australia is offering an additional 10,000 USDG prize pool for the best Australian projects competing in Colosseum’s Crypto World’s Fair.

Crypto World’s Fair brings builders from across the world’s leading blockchain ecosystems into one open competition. This side track is our way of backing the strongest Australian founders taking part.

Whether you have been building on Solana for years or are entering the ecosystem for the first time, if you are building an ambitious product on Solana and at least one member of your founding team is based in Australia, you are eligible.

Prizes

  • 1st place: 6,000 USDG

  • 2nd place: 2,000 USDG

  • 3rd place: 1,000 USDG

  • Two bonus prizes: 500 USDG each

The bonus prizes will recognise two standout projects outside the top three that demonstrate exceptional promise, execution or originality.

These prizes are in addition to anything you may win through Crypto World’s Fair, including the US$100,000 Solana ecosystem track, general awards and potential consideration for the Colosseum Accelerator.

Eligibility

To qualify for this side track:

  • Your project must be entered into the Solana ecosystem track of Crypto World’s Fair.

  • At least one founder or core team member must be based in Australia.

  • You must comply with the official Crypto World’s Fair rules and submission requirements.

  • Your project must be submitted to both Crypto World’s Fair and this Superteam Earn listing by the relevant deadlines.

  • You must provide a working product or prototype that the judges can evaluate.

Teams may enter from anywhere in Australia, including university teams, first-time founders and established builders launching something new.

What we are looking for

We want to see products with the potential to become real, enduring startups.

Projects will be assessed on:

  • Product: Does it work, and is the experience compelling?

  • Problem: Is the team solving something meaningful for a clearly defined user?

  • Originality: Is the project meaningfully different from what already exists?

  • Use of Solana: Does Solana materially improve the product?

  • Execution: How much has the team built during the competition?

  • Potential: Could this develop into a globally significant company?

A polished pitch deck is not a substitute for a functioning product. Screenshots, product demonstrations and real user activity will carry more weight than a long roadmap.

How to enter

  1. Register for Crypto World’s Fair using the Superteam Australia sign-up link and ensure you select Australia as your location.

  2. Enter your project in the Solana ecosystem track.

  3. Complete your official Crypto World’s Fair submission by October 12, 2026 at 11:59PM PDT.

  4. Submit your project to this Superteam Earn side track with:

    • Your project name and a short description

    • The names and locations of your Australian team members

    • Your Crypto World’s Fair project or submission link

    • A working product link

    • A public product demonstration video

    • Your project’s X account and relevant social links

    • Any traction, users or other evidence of progress

For more information and support, visit au.superteam.fun/colosseum.

More than prize money

Superteam Australia exists to be an early believer in ambitious Australian founders.

The strongest teams may also receive ongoing support through introductions, distribution, ecosystem connections, mentorship and future non-dilutive funding opportunities.

We do not take equity, tokens or shares. Founders keep 100% of what they build.

Steel sharpens steel. This is Australia’s opportunity to compete with the best builders in the world and show what we are capable of.

Build something real. Put it in front of the world. Make Australia impossible to ignore.
